_about: Sexual assault support near BC campuses: community sexual assault support programs and hospitals with 24-hour sexual assault or forensic nurse examiner care. Every entry is from the organization's own site or its health authority, checked 2026-10-03 (EVA BC's directory of Sexual Assault Services programs was used to find programs). No transition houses or shelters, and no address that isn't publicly listed: where only a phone number is public, the entry has no location. Coordinates are geocoded from the listed address with OpenStreetMap Nominatim. service_area lists the cities a program says it serves (null: no area restriction is published); a campus is only routed to a program that serves its city. Organizations that also run a transition house or shelter are left out entirely, even at a separate public office.
